$schema: Per-panorama narration. `text` is spoken via Web Speech API; optional `audioUrl` overrides.

scripts.main-gate: Welcome to PYDAH College. You are standing at the main gate, our grand entrance. Straight ahead lies the tree-lined avenue leading to the central circle.
scripts.straight-road: This tree-lined arterial road connects the main gate to the central campus. Take a moment to enjoy the greenery.
scripts.main-circle: You have reached the main circle — the heart of the campus. From here, every academic block, ground and facility is a short walk away.
scripts.engineering-block: This is the Engineering Block, home to CSE, ECE, the Principal's office, and the administrative wing.
scripts.cse-department: Welcome to the Computer Science and Engineering department, featuring an AI and ML lab, cybersecurity range, and full-stack project studio.
scripts.ece-department: The Electronics and Communication Engineering department houses embedded systems, VLSI and communication labs.
scripts.admission-block: Welcome to the Admission Cell. Our team handles enquiries, counselling and document verification for new students.
scripts.cafeteria: This is our campus cafeteria — a lively hub for meals, snacks and conversations between classes.
scripts.seminar-hall: The Seminar Hall hosts guest lectures, workshops and department events throughout the year.
scripts.open-ground: The Open Ground hosts our biggest events — sports days, cultural festivals and community gatherings.
scripts.degree-block: This is the Degree Block — home to arts, science and commerce classrooms.
